Hero/heavy beat cuts occur on a hitstop tick

name: Step per cut is 1 or 2 (45-90 deg)
Cooldown: none <36 ticks; none <90 unless higher priority
Air lockout: zero cuts while E airborne and not spiked
detail: literal: 51 cuts in lockout ({"launcher":51}). 51 are the launcher cut on the launching hit (<=6 ticks after air start, on hitstop), which spec section 5 explicitly allows; non-launch cuts in air: 0. Code also exempts 'heavy' from the lockout (spec says no beat may cut); soak produced 0 heavy beats so that path is untested
